data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall deterioration on prior years' reserves of GBP 1.776m in 2015 (gross), driven predominantly by a GBP 3.356m adverse development in the fire & other damage to property class, partially offset by improvements of GBP 1.275m in marine, aviation & transport and GBP 0.344m in reinsurance acceptances. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 218.224m.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding, gross) at 31 Dec 2014. Prior year development uses the explicit narrative 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (gross) on page 36. Individual LOB movements are stated explicitly in that note. Claims development triangle is present but aggregates 'Before 2011' which is excluded from the underwriting_years list; some development rows have values only in the aggregate column and therefore appear as null for the individual UW year columns. No gross PYD breakdown by all years beyond the items quoted is provided; where only net figures might appear elsewhere they were not used because a gross movement was explicitly provided.
